correctness.rationale: The exact spherical pair density gives mean (b+c)pi/2, tails of order t^-2, clipped variance 2(b^2+c^2)log t+O(1), and fourth moment O(t^2). Cutoff n(log n)^(1/4) makes all discarded pairs vanish with probability 1-o(1). Rotation invariance yields a degenerate kernel. A bounded Schur operator norm and tr(H^4)<=||H||^2 tr(H^2) make predictable quadratic variation concentrate; the fourth-moment bound yields the martingale Lindeberg condition. Cramer-Wold proves the rank-two limit. The actual CHECK.py passed 31 analytic/numerical assertions; finite checks are not an infinite proof.
